description: This file defines an Orleans grain interface 'IPingGrain' within the 'BenchmarkGrainInterfaces.Ping' namespace. It specifies asynchronous methods 'Run' and 'PingPongInterleave' with a concurrency attribute.

classes.name: IPingGrain
classes.description: An interface for a grain that handles ping-pong messaging with interleaving capability.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Initiates the grain's primary operation asynchronously.

methods.name: PingPongInterleave
methods.description: Performs a ping-pong operation with another grain, supporting concurrent interleaving, parameters include the target grain and the count.
